interface.shortDescription: Recognize and celebrate coworkers with Assembly
interface.longDescription: Bring Assembly employee recognition into your AI assistant. Look up coworkers and groups, check your available points and company values, find recognition opportunities and upcoming celebrations on your team, and draft specific, evidence-based recognition messages. Every recognition is previewed and posted only after you confirm.
